decoder: unchanged Stage2E greedy CTC; optional baseline-only width10 prefix beam is separate diagnostic
synthetic_convention: Known renderer-slot masks, zero deskew, row-union width, xpad=0.25H, ypad=max(6,0.15H), keep_faint_v1. H=count ink span. Oracle isolation, not a replay of photograph-specific segmentation; no ruling present. Stroke halo kernel=odd max(3,int(2*max distance transform)).

transforms.B_contrast: foreground p5 blackpoint mapped to 0; white=255
transforms.D_dilation: grayscale one-pixel cross erosion at model height64 (dark ink dilation), no threshold
transforms.E_tight_vertical: all nonwhite vertical bbox + 10% span white pad >=2px, full width
transforms.F_glyph_height: vertical ink span remapped to synthetic per-role median fraction on unchanged canvas, no horizontal change

distribution_note: Ink threshold<250; component area>=2px; stroke width proxy=2*distance on local medial ridges; multipart notation means components are not semantic glyphs. Padding and occupied span are threshold-dependent proxies, not reader verification.
